title: Yara and the Colony
author: Mirabel Sterling
blurb: Freya Dunmore, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
